text.description_html:
Grandeur CHKCLA, Classic Coat Hook

Although it is called classic, there is nothing traditional or boring about this hook, the slotted design is alluring and can be easily incorporated into any decor from a southwestern ranch to a modern apartment in NewYork. This Grandeur hook is perfect for holding winter coats and hats; but it is so versatile it will be just as useful mounted in closets, in the bathroom for towels, in the kitchen for cooking utensils or just about anywhere you can think of. Hooks in every room is a great way to help end clutter. However, what is great about this hook is that it will look alluring no matter where you surface mount it; the unique design means that the Classic Coat Hook is stylish enough that it can be put right out in the open.

Over the years, Grandeur products have amassed a nationwide following of clients. Customers include thousands of antique dealers, restoration contractors, homeowners, builders, architects and others, just like you. The Grandeur line is also a favorite among Hollywood art directors. The company's products have been used in over 150 films and television programs.

Click here to see the entire Grandeur Nostalgic Warehouse Collection

Features of the Grandeur Classic Coat Hook:

  • Coat Hook Height: 4-1/4"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 robe hook and all necessary mounting screws.

No matter which finish you choose for the outside, it will still be solid brass material inside.
